'''Bur Veujarij''' was a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who worked at the [[Imperial Institute of Military Medicine|Imperial Institue of Military Medicine]] and studied the aging of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] sometime around [[8 BBY/Legends|8 BBY]]. He wrote the article "[[Aging and Tissue Regeneration in Kaminoan-cloned Troops]]" for [[Imperial Medical Review 1675]].
